converter_layout_rules: TI ISOW1432/1044 converter10nF0402 within1mm of actual VDD9/GND10 or VISOOUT12/GND11 pair; bulk after that cap,2–4mm from it.
Symmetric power/return loops. Both power and return ferrites are actual components, with raw and filtered isolated nets kept distinct.

TI section9.4.1 also requires converter-output routing/pour exclusions within4mm of pins11/12; reconcile exact allowed own-power/capacitor paths with vendor layout drawing, preserve required creepage. This report does not measure or waive that native PCB gate.
